venues.name: Sotavento, Fuerteventura

windZones.note: The trades accelerate along Jandía's coast and blow harder out beyond the Playa Barca sandbar; close to the beach the wind is lighter and gustier. A qualitative mapping: about 4 kt more over the outer half of the heat (from 300 m out), 3 kt less within 90 m of the beach.

venues.character: Steady summer NE trades, a bright low-tide lagoon and small left-breaking shore waves near the main break.
venues.profileNote: The heat is framed against Playa Barca: lagoon and sandbar out front, the judging tower and René Egli beach centre on shore, and the Jandía ridges behind. The water stays calmer landward of the bar and roughens toward the Atlantic.
venues.courseNote: The wind blows side-shore, a little offshore, along the beach, like the NE trades. The heat centre sits about 316 m out, its nearest corner about 90 m clear of the beach. The sandbar crosses the heat just on the beach side of its centre, and the lagoon inside it is flatter. The scene is mirrored to keep the beach in view: here the wind comes from your right as you look out to sea; at Sotavento it comes from your left.
landmarks: Playa Barca judging tower, grandstand and competition tents
René Egli windsurf centre and low resort buildings
Wind-shaped golden dunes with the Jandía ridge behind
waterZones: Turquoise, calmer lagoon on the shoreward side of the sandbar
A shallow, foamy sandbar line at the lagoon's outer edge
Darker, more textured Atlantic water and a small left-breaking shore wave

venues.name: Westerland, Sylt

windZones.note: An onshore westerly arrives evenly over open water; out over the sand ridge it is a little stronger. A qualitative mapping: about 2 kt more from 380 m out.

venues.character: Exposed west-facing North Sea water; onshore westerlies can bring steep shorebreak, while offshore easterlies can leave the nearshore water much flatter.
venues.profileNote: The heat faces Westerland's open beach: the sand ridge and trough sit offshore, rocky groynes cross the shorebreak, and the Musikmuschel and promenade mark the town side. Wave size and water state vary sharply with wind and tide.
venues.courseNote: The wind blows side-onshore, at 45° onto the beach, like a south-westerly. The heat centre sits about 326 m out, its nearest corner about 100 m clear of the beach; the sand ridge, about 400 m out, crosses the seaward part of the heat. The scene is mirrored to keep the beach in view: here the wind comes from your right as you look out to sea; at Westerland a south-westerly comes from your left.
landmarks: Brandenburger Strand event beach and competition tents
Westerland promenade, sea wall and Musikmuschel shell stage
Blue-and-white Strandkörbe and rock groynes with beach markers
waterZones: Open North Sea swell and choppy water outside the shorebreak
A submerged sand ridge around 400 m out with a deeper trough behind it
A steep shorebreak in onshore westerlies; flatter-looking nearshore water in offshore easterlies

venues.name: Prasonisi, Rhodes
venues.place: Prasonisi, southern tip of Rhodes, Greece

windPatch.note: The meltemi jets between Rhodes and the islet over the sandbar neck and out across the south of the bay (the Kite and Windsurfing Guide: it “jets between the mountain and a small island”). A qualitative mapping: 6 kt more where it leaves the neck, carried about 1 km downwind and fading over 320 m to either side; the course’s south end feels its edge.

venues.character: The summer meltemi from the north-west, sped up between Rhodes and the islet, blows across a sandbar: waves on the Aegean side, flat water on the leeward side.
venues.profileNote: Prasonisi built from map data, the true way round: the golden sandbar joining Rhodes to the rocky islet with its lighthouse, the bare hills of the south with their low scrub, the windsurf centres at the foot of the hill, and the sea turning from turquoise over sand to deep Aegean blue.
venues.courseNote: The meltemi blows across the sandbar and out over the flat-water bay, cross-offshore, as at the real spot. The heat sits in the bay off the leeward beach, about 110 m clear of it, with the Kirschner and Wind4Fun centres on the shore upwind. The wave side lies beyond the sandbar. Nothing is mirrored: the bay, the islet and the hills are where a map puts them.
landmarks: Surfcenter Kirschner and Wind4Fun, with rigs on the sand of the flat-water beach
The sandbar to Prasonisi islet, with camper vans parked on it
Prasonisi lighthouse (1890) on the islet’s southern tip
waterZones: Turquoise shallows over sand along the leeward beach
Flat water in the bay, a little choppier further out
Darker, gustier water where the wind jets past the islet at the bay’s south end
Waves breaking on the Aegean side beyond the sandbar

venues.name: Pozo Izquierdo, Gran Canaria
venues.character: Very strong, gusty side-shore trades over deep Atlantic water and swell, off a boulder beach. Summer trades often blow above 30 kt, beyond the game's 28.
venues.profileNote: No scenery yet: the game's own open water, in Pozo's usual wind.

venues.name: Sorobon, Bonaire
locations: Sorbon Beach, Bonaire, Dutch Netherlands Antilles
venues.character: Steady easterly trades, side-shore, over a flat, shallow turquoise lagoon behind a reef.
venues.profileNote: Lac Bay built from map data, the true way round: the shallow lagoon with its sandy shallows and seagrass, the reef across the mouth with surf breaking on it, the mangroves around the bay, and Sorobon beach with its windsurf centres and resort.
venues.courseNote: The trade wind blows from the reef across the lagoon towards Sorobon beach, as at the real spot. The heat sits in the lagoon inside the reef, with the beach about 117 m beyond it. Nothing is mirrored: the bay and its landmarks are where a map puts them.
